storyCards.headline: One Night In Bangkok: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Murray Head's "One Night In Bangkok" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

One Night In Bangkok was released in 1985.

Chart story — peaked at #3 on the Hot 100.
